newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: SOCCER-ETHIOPIAN FEDERATION MEETS OVER DEFECTIONS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ETHIOPIAN FEDERATION MEETS OVER DEFECTIONS.

text.p: Ethiopia's Football Federation met on Wednesday to decide whether to pull out of the African Nations' Cup because 16 members of the national side have defected in Italy.
Federation official Sebsebe Haile Mariam said an announcement was expected later on Wednesday or Thursday.
The federation has told the Cairo-based African Football Confederation that Ethiopia's team was unable to play Morocco after the 16 disappeared in Rome and missed a flight to Casablanca.
Mariam said the remaining seven members who did not defect were returning to Addis Ababa later on Wednesday.
